core_obligations: Derive the four properties of F = F(R) from the equivalence.
At a closed point: F_x nonzero finite free of positive rank in a neighbourhood (lift property + fp stalk criterion).
Force rank 1 via property (3) and the surjection Hom(F, F) → Hom(F, i_*i^*F).
Conclude H^1 vanishing for all QCoh modules and apply the affine criterion.
proof_roadmap: four properties → invertible generator → Ext^1 vanishing → affine criterion
difficulty_reason: Full execution: the equivalence gives F = F(R) with four properties (fp by categorically-compact-QCoh, Hom exact, commutative endomorphism ring, generator); at a closed point x, property (4) shows F_x ≠ 0, property (2) lifts maps to O_{X,x}, fp + modules-lemma-finite-presentation-stalk-free makes F finite locally free of positive rank around closed points, property (3) forces rank 1 (surjectivity of Hom(F, F) → Hom(F, i_*i^*F)), so F is invertible; then Γ = Hom(F, - ⊗ F) is exact, Ext^1 in QCoh = Ext^1 in Mod (extensions closure, schemes-section-quasi-coherent), hence H^1(X, H) = 0 for all QCoh H, and X is affine by coherent-lemma-quasi-compact-h1-zero-covering.
